body: Audit 2026-10-11 (H1, OPS-6). POST /api/owner/listings/[slug]/checkout is still live although the UI uses hosted-checkout. Its purchases have no provider_resource_id or payment_periods row, so Stripe events go to processStripeEvent (src/lib/payment-events.ts:88), which handles only checkout success and charge.refunded and records charge.dispute.* as processed without effect. An owner can pay through the legacy route, file a chargeback, and keep featured placement for the paid period. Migrated legacy purchases also cannot be reconciled: version 9 added provider_resource_id without a backfill, and recovery rejects resource-less paid purchases even with --resource cs_... (src/lib/payment-reconciliation.ts:233). Disable the legacy route and move legacy purchases onto the payment lifecycle without granting a second period, or add dispute handling and a legacy recovery path.

body: Audit 2026-10-11 (H2, verified). PATCH /api/admin/listings/[slug] reads the listing at line 13, then awaits the body, then checks the moderation rule against that stale status at line 28. updateListing (src/lib/listings.ts) overwrites status without rechecking, and the body is merged as {...existing, ...changes}, so a body without status writes the old status back. A catalog-only user's routine edit that overlaps a moderator's suspension republishes the listing; a slow body widens the window. Recheck current status and the actor's moderation permission inside the immediate transaction and reject stale writes with an expected revision.
title: Promote listing-edit-reverses-suspension
